scripts.name: Ep1 The Haircut
scripts.text:
PREMISE: Dev can't tell Rocky his haircut is a disaster; asks for 'thoda kam', gets worse; tells Meera he'll get it fixed tomorrow - by Rocky.
HUMAN TRUTH: we can't complain to the person who did a bad job, even when we pay them.
l1 Rocky: Lo guru! Dekho zara... ekdam Korean hero! Bhaukaal hai, bhaukaal!
l2 Dev: Haan... achha hai... bahut... alag hai.
l3 Dev (inner voice): Dev! Office mein client ko 'No' bol deta hai... aur naai se darr gaya? Bol!
l4 Dev: Bhaiya... bas side se... thoda sa... kam kar dijiye?
l5 Rocky: Thoda kam? Ho jaayega! Tension kaahe lete ho guru... Baal hain, sarkari naukri nahi. Dobara mil jaayenge!
(black beat: snip snip)
l6 Rocky: ...Oho.
l7 Dev: ...Achha hai.
l8 Meera: Ee ka kar aaye? Baal katwaane gaye the... ki daan karke aaye?
l9 Dev: Kal jaake theek karwa lunga.
l10 Meera: Usi se?
l11 Dev: Haan... warna wo bura maan jaayega.
l12 Rocky: Aao guru! Baitho... aaj kya karein? (loops back to the first shot)
